design_axis: conventional functional platform icon carrier treatment
bounded_question: How should conventional Windows/Fluent software verbs sit inside the selected static APP VISUAL system without redrawing platform meaning, spreading accent color, or turning MAT/STA mechanisms into decorative icon chrome?
controlled_inputs: Frozen conventional meanings: Back, Close, Search, Settings, More, Navigation disclosure, Play, Pause
Same Segoe Fluent Icons/Segoe MDL2 fallback glyph meanings in CNEG/F1/F2/F3
Selected Light F2 and Dark D3 roles
MAT F1, TYP F1 and STA F2 constraints
Exact frozen wide and narrow normal-color evidence
excluded_variables: Production token or shipping asset selection

local_result.summary: Exactly one eligible treatment survives frozen subjective falsification: F1 Native Quiet Carrier.
rejections: F2 - persistent boundary chrome becomes a repetitive control/widget matrix
F3 - MAT subtractive topology becomes decorative per-icon hook anatomy

judgment.design_sol_view: F1 is the only treatment that keeps familiar platform verbs visually quiet and semantically native while preserving independent focus/selection structure, sparse accent use and Light/Dark parity.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: Director explicitly delegated execution of the frozen subjective falsification and subsequent closure to Design Sol; no independent Director score was requested or fabricated.

accessibility: Seven-case preflight passed: 1600/1024/390/320, forced-colors 320, 200% text 320, text-spacing stress 320
Focus-visible remains a structural 2px ring independent of icon color
Selection remains structurally witnessed rather than color-only

requires: Light F2 / Dark D3 static APP VISUAL system
constrains: Conventional platform verbs in later APP VISUAL composition should default to F1 quiet-carrier treatment unless an explicit successor gate supersedes this packet.
must_not_be_confused_with: Final icon family or production asset package

known_integration_sensitivities: Dense toolbars must preserve F1's quiet at-rest hierarchy rather than adding persistent boxes by convenience.
Selection accent may reinforce a structural witness but teal must not become default icon or status color.
Labeled controls may still use architecture-required control boundaries; F1 does not mean borderless controls everywhere.
explicit_non_authority: No production token API, final shipping icon assets, WinUI/XAML mapping, package or Store authority.
No bespoke domain glyphs or Product-gated symbol vocabulary.
No Threshold K/app-icon/wordmark geometry inside interface icons.
No Stage, website palette or shared-brand-final authority.

director_review_surface.entry_point: Drive wide + narrow APPUI-FICON-01 frozen matrix PNGs
director_review_surface.what_to_review: CNEG/F1/F2/F3 carrier treatment across selected Light F2 and Dark D3 at wide and narrow layouts
